rubric.why: Oxidation is defined as gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen.
rubric.description: States one correct definition of oxidation.
rubric.how: Award for either gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen.

rubric.why: Reduction is defined as loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen.
rubric.description: States one correct definition of reduction.
rubric.how: Award for either loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen.

modelAnswer: Oxidation is the gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen.
Reduction is the loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen.

items.followUp: Write the balanced chemical equation for photosynthesis.

rubric.why: These are the reactants in the respiration equation, in the correct proportions.
rubric.description: Gives glucose and oxygen as reactants with correct coefficients.
rubric.how: Look for C₆H₁₂O₆ and 6O₂ on the reactant side.

rubric.why: These are the products shown in the balanced respiration equation.
rubric.description: Gives carbon dioxide, water, and energy as products with correct coefficients.
rubric.how: Look for 6CO₂, 6H₂O, and energy on the product side.

items.followUp: What is meant by aerobic respiration?

rubric.why: The defining feature of anaerobes is that they can live in the absence of oxygen.
rubric.description: States that they can live without oxygen.
rubric.how: Look for either phrase expressing absence of oxygen.

modelAnswer: Anaerobes are organisms that can live in the absence of oxygen.
